'''Monotremes''' were a subclass of [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] that laid [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]. The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had characteristics of both monotremes and [[Bird/Legends|avians]].<ref name="Card-CCG-Kal'Falnl C'ndros">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Kal'Falnl C'ndros}}</ref>
